description: This file defines the SecureSocketPort class and its nested classes, including Certificate and Handler, for managing secure socket connections with SSL/TLS, certificate validation, and resource handling within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: Represents a secure socket port with SSL/TLS capabilities, resource management, and callback handling.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate
classes.description: Encapsulates an X.509 certificate and its associated SSL context, providing methods for issuer, subject, validity, hostname validation, and verification.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: Manages socket connection states, SSL handshake, data transmission, and resource events.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket port is open.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the socket port is closed.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the socket port is suspended.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::HasError
methods.description: Checks if the socket port has an error.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier of the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::LocalNode
methods.description: Sets the local node for the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteNode
methods.description: Sets the remote node for the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteNode (getter)
methods.description: Returns the remote node of the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Open
methods.description: Opens the socket connection with a specified wait time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Close
methods.description: Closes the socket connection with a specified wait time.
